user.description: Home Assistant bonds with the lock through the host's Bluetooth adapter, the same way a phone is added in the EZVIZ app. Close the EZVIZ app (or turn off your phone's Bluetooth) during setup: the lock accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time.

data_description.address: The lock advertises its serial number as its Bluetooth name.
data_description.management_code: The lock's 6 digit management code: the one you set in the EZVIZ app, or, if it was never changed, the default on the battery cover label (0 followed by the last five digits of the serial number). Repeated wrong codes may lock you out for a while.
data_description.account: The e-mail address (or phone number, if the account has no e-mail) of the EZVIZ account that added the lock. The lock only accepts commands for users it knows.

error.invalid_code: The lock rejected the management code. If you changed it in the EZVIZ app, the default code from the battery cover no longer works.
error.user_not_registered: The lock does not know this account.
error.not_found: The lock is no longer in Bluetooth range.
error.pairing_not_possible: The lock needs to be bonded, which only works through a local (BlueZ) Bluetooth adapter, not through a Bluetooth proxy.
error.pairing_failed: Bonding with the lock failed. If this happens right after the code is sent, the management code is probably wrong (see its description). Otherwise close the EZVIZ app or turn off your phone's Bluetooth and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to the lock. Close the EZVIZ app or turn off your phone's Bluetooth and try again.
error.not_seen_locally: The host's Bluetooth adapter has not seen the lock yet. Make sure the lock is in range of the Home Assistant host and try again in a minute.

abort.no_devices_found: No connectable Bluetooth devices found. Make sure the lock is in Bluetooth range and try again.

create_entry.default: Paired with the lock. If Home Assistant can't reconnect to it after this (polls fail, the lock shows unavailable), apply the one-time Bluetooth key fix on the Home Assistant host described in the README.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to read the lock state. Each read is a Bluetooth connection, which uses lock battery.

user_not_registered.message: The lock does not know the configured EZVIZ account.

command_failed.message: The lock did not execute the command: {error}

pin_exists.message: The lock already has this PIN.

pin_not_found.message: The lock has no PIN for this user index.

pin_storage_full.message: The lock cannot store more PINs.

invalid_window.message: The PIN must become valid before it expires.

invalid_schedule.message: A weekly schedule needs weekdays, a start time and a later end time (it cannot cross midnight).

invalid_name.message: The name is empty or longer than 32 bytes.

list_pins.name: List PINs
list_pins.description: Lists the keypad PINs stored on the lock: user index, name and whether the PIN is currently valid. The codes themselves are not returned.

add_pin.name: Add PIN
add_pin.description: Stores a keypad PIN on the lock. Each PIN becomes its own lock user; the response contains its user index. Optionally limit when the PIN works.

pin.name: PIN
pin.description: 6 to 10 digits. Shorter codes are refused: the keypad also opens for longer entries that contain a stored PIN.

name.name: Name
name.description: Shown in the PIN list and in door opened events (up to 32 bytes).

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: The PIN works from this moment (local time).

valid_until.name: Valid until
valid_until.description: The PIN stops working after this moment (local time).

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Only on these days. Requires a start and end time.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Daily start of the period on the selected weekdays.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: Daily end of the period (exclusive, same day).

delete_pin.name: Delete PIN
delete_pin.description: Deletes a keypad PIN and the lock user it belongs to.

user_index.name: User index
user_index.description: The PIN's user index from the PIN list.
